t_advice_summary_textbox.text: brown and taller gnomes give more mushrooms. keep your fingers on S and K and keep paying attention to press space

vb_textbox.text: Keep fingers on the S and K keys. I was advised bigger, and brown, gnomes tended to find more. Unclear on correlation. Go on vibes too, mix it up. Don't know if it had anything to do with it but I started delaying space when in the forest (counting 1 2 3 in my head) and was getting some good 5x bonuses - 40 / 45 etc. I don't think there's a particular pattern. Little orange tended to do well but not always. Didn't find the brown to be as compelling as the person before me suggested.
